what: Does the frozen-feature peritumoral gain (+0.075, 10/10 seeds, p=0.002) survive end-to-end training with model.peritumoral_features=true?
answer: Directionally yes, 3/3 seeds, but at the edge of what n=153 resolves. Significance depends on an analysis choice made after seeing the data, so it is reported as suggestive, not established.
caveat: The 3-seed analysis is restricted to n=122 because the seed-1337 BASELINE has a stalled fold; the 2-seed analysis uses the full n=153 but drops a seed after the fact. Neither is pre-specified. base-s1337-rerun is training to remove the degenerate baseline so the 3-seed analysis can stand on the full cohort.
